job.style: a conversation between a teacher and two students

passage: Teacher: Today, let us discuss how light behaves. Rohan, is the Moon a luminous object like the Sun? Rohan: Yes, because it glows brightly at night. Teacher: Actually, the Moon is non-luminous; it only reflects sunlight. Light travels in a straight line, which is why we cannot see around corners. If you place a solid object in the path of light, a shadow forms on a screen. Priya: Does the shadow change size if I move the object closer to the light source? Teacher: Yes, the shadow size changes depending on the distance between the object and the screen. Also, remember that a shadow is simply an area where light is blocked; it is not a physical object. Some materials, like clear glass, are transparent and allow light to pass through, while others reflect light even if they are not shiny mirrors. For instance, a wooden table reflects light, which is how you see it, even if you cannot see your own face in it. Light does not bend around obstacles, and it certainly does not travel further at night. Shadows require a surface to be visible; without a screen, there is no shadow to see. Light always travels in a straight path, ensuring that shadows are formed only when an object obstructs that path.

items.evidence: Actually, the Moon is non-luminous; it only reflects sunlight.
items.q: The Moon shines brightly at night. Why is it still not called a luminous object?
options: It only sends back light from the Sun
It makes its own light only at night
Its light travels further in the dark
Its glow is weaker than the Sun's glow
items.explain: The Moon does not make light; it only reflects sunlight, so it is non-luminous.

wrong.why: thinks glowing at night means it is luminous
thinks light travels further at night
thinks luminous depends on brightness, not making light

items.evidence: Light travels in a straight line, which is why we cannot see around corners.
items.q: Meena stands behind a wall. Why can't she see her friend around the corner?
options: Light moves only along straight paths
Light bends round but becomes too weak
Light travels less far during the day
Light is stopped by the wall's solid shadow
items.explain: Light travels in a straight line, so it cannot go around the corner to her eyes.

wrong.why: thinks light can bend around corners
thinks light's reach changes with day and night
thinks a shadow is a solid thing

items.evidence: Also, remember that a shadow is simply an area where light is blocked; it is not a physical object.
items.q: Amit says his shadow follows him like a dark copy. What is a shadow really?
options: A place that light cannot reach
A dark copy made of thin matter
A reflection of the body, like a mirror
A dark shape that floats in the air
items.explain: A shadow is just an area where light is blocked; it is not a real object.

wrong.why: thinks a shadow is a physical thing
mixes up shadows with mirror images
thinks shadows exist without a surface

items.evidence: For instance, a wooden table reflects light, which is how you see it, even if you cannot see your own face in it.
items.q: You cannot see your face in a wooden table. How can you still see the table?
options: It reflects some light to your eyes
It reflects only if polished like a mirror
It lets light pass through like glass
It gives out its own faint light
items.explain: A wooden table reflects light even though it is not shiny, and that is how we see it.

wrong.why: thinks only mirrors and shiny things reflect
mixes up the table with transparent glass
thinks things we see must glow by themselves

items.evidence: Shadows require a surface to be visible; without a screen, there is no shadow to see.
items.q: A torch lights a ball with nothing behind it. Where can its shadow be seen?
options: Only on a screen placed behind it
In the air just behind the ball
On the ball itself, as a reflection
Around the ball, as light bends past it
items.explain: Shadows need a surface to be visible; without a screen there is no shadow to see.

wrong.why: thinks shadows show without a surface
thinks a shadow is a reflection
